cause: Both cxi/cxi/cxi0 endpoints opened and exchanged native traffic. At the full 83-shard layout one rank completed its local contribution state first and began redistribution while its peer still had contribution work. The peer rejected the early fetch as an unexpected contribution-stage frame; the first rank then rejected the peer's late contribution control frame during redistribution. The native gate lacked a fenced peer-to-peer phase-ready exchange between contribution completion and redistribution.
correction: Use the existing authenticated result_announce frame as a strict frozen-generation peer readiness exchange. Each rank announces only after its local contribution state is complete and accepts a live peer announce only when run, fence, generation, attempt, owner epoch, layout, and base match; neither rank may enter redistribution until both are ready.
